dct_description_sm: This is a georeferenced chart of the Strait of Juan de Fuca  survey by Capt Henry Kellett 1847 with Admiralty Inlet & Puget Sound by US Exploring Expedition 1841, with MS additions. Admiralty Chart 1911. About 3 sea miles to an inch. [Juan de Fuca, Strait, 1849]. J. & C. Walker, Sculpt. Soundings in fathoms. Shows First Nations sites and territories.
